say:1:1423184001:1.text: I looked forward to it at first, but not so much after the crisis hit the village...
say:1:1423184001:1.source_cn: 之前想，后来村子出了事不想了……

say:2:1423184002:0.text: But things are looking up now! There's nothing to worry about if the envoy shows up.
say:2:1423184002:0.source_cn: 现在不是村子又好起来了嘛，特使来视察视察也没啥吧。

say:3:1423184003:1.text: I wouldn't miss the welcome banquet for anything! I've been craving those turkey drumsticks from last time!
say:3:1423184003:1.source_cn: 要是特使来了，我们还能沾沾光去吃接风宴，我可想念上次宴...
